targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-780 (DIAGNOSTIC, GOV-FANOUT-1 H-bc-prior leg, demonstrator-based imitation axis) PROMOTES AND DEMOTES NOTHING; MECH-457 stays candidate/v3_pending. Its self-route `bc_prior_not_the_axis` is REJECTED on autopsy and H-bc-prior is NOT eliminated -- it stays ALIVE on the competence_floor question, re-posed. The manifest's pre-registered null is verbatim 'treat still forages ~0 both reps'; in raw_view treat forages 11.667 at unshaped D3 (17.993 train-recent, 20.933 immediately post-BC), so the null's ANTECEDENT IS FALSIFIED and its consequent must not be applied. The experiment's own declared covariate decides this: load_bearing_dv states 'post_bc_foraging_competence separates seed never took from seed erased by RL', and it fires into two branches, NEITHER of which is the self-route. z_world: post_bc 0.583 with 0/3 seeds taking the BC seed -- the manipulation was NEVER INSTALLED, so this arm cannot speak to the hypothesis. raw_view: post_bc 20.933 with 3/3 seeds taking -- the manipulation WAS installed, ABOVE the 13.05 lift-competence target and inside the 32.72 BC-expert / 48.05 local-view-ceiling band -- and RL then ERODED it to 11.667. Readiness met (local_view_greedy 48.05, greedy_oracle 57.2 vs the 1.0 floor); non_degenerate=True; criteria_non_degenerate all true -- the defect is in the interpretation grid, which enumerated only a ~0 null, not in the instrumentation. HIGH-VALUE POSITIVE FINDING: this is the FIRST observation in the entire competence_floor campaign of the agent exceeding the lift-competence target (20.933 vs 13.05) on this substrate. The campaign's question therefore changes shape -- from 'can competence be produced' to 'why is produced competence not RETAINED'. V3-EXQ-782 R-(b) supplies the leading mechanism candidate: a flat, uninformed critic on the shared CTRL path (std(V)/std(G) = 0.041 against a 0.25 collapse threshold; pre-reward-vs-far separation 0.016 against a 0.25 floor) yields an unbaselined, high-variance advantage -- precisely what drifts a policy off an installed prior. Secondary finding: the z_world imitation pathway is an implementation gap in its own right (a detached z_world could not absorb a local_view_greedy demonstrator at all, 0/3). Routed to a retention re-pose under a NEW EXQ number; the re-derive brake permits it as a new question (retention vs discovery) with a new null and a positive control, NOT a same-axis re-pose.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.rationale: The retention bottleneck is a DISCRIMINATION (which of: flat critic baseline / absent consolidation pathway / imitation-auxiliary decay schedule), not one unambiguous named build. Routing a single build now would commit substrate work on one non-load-bearing covariate. Fan out first -- see fanout_recommendation.

re_derive_brake.note: MECH-457 carries 6 prior substrate_ceiling/non_contributory autopsies. The brake nonetheless PERMITS the recommended re-pose, on the same grounds it permitted 780 and 781 themselves: this is not another config/env/credit/capacity letter circling the same ceiling. It is a DIFFERENT QUESTION (retention of installed competence, not discovery of competence), with a different null, a different measurement (competence trajectory post-installation rather than terminal competence), and -- decisively -- a POSITIVE CONTROL that no prior leg possessed (raw_view reached 20.933). Every one of the 6 braked autopsies adjudicated a treatment arm that never left the ~0-1 floor; this one adjudicates a treatment arm that reached 20.933 and fell. The brake's refusal target is a same-axis re-pose against an unchanged ceiling, and this is not that. Recorded explicitly so the /queue-experiment Step 2.5 consumer half can see the reasoning rather than re-deriving it.

learning_extracted: H-bc-prior is NOT eliminated. Its declared null required 'treat still forages ~0 both reps' and raw_view returned 11.667 eval / 20.933 post-BC. Applying the null's consequent when its antecedent is falsified would have written a confident-but-wrong elimination into the frozen ledger -- the exact failure GOV-FANOUT-1 exists to prevent.

A behavioural prior CAN reach lift-competence on this substrate (20.933 > the 13.05 target, inside the 32.72 expert band) -- the first such observation in the whole competence_floor campaign. The bottleneck is not producing competence but RETAINING it.

RL degrades an installed competent prior here (20.933 -> 11.667), inverting the biological expectation that reward-driven refinement improves an imitated skill. That inversion is the load-bearing divergence and it localises to the value-baseline/retention pathway.

782 R-(b) and 780 raw_view interlock into one mechanism: a flat, uninformed critic (std(V)/std(G) = 0.041, separation 0.016) produces an unbaselined high-variance advantage, which is what erodes an installed policy. Neither run alone supports this; the cluster does.

The z_world imitation pathway is a separate implementation gap: 0/3 seeds absorbed the demonstrator (post_bc 0.583) where raw_view absorbed it 3/3 at 20.933. A detached z_world could not be taught by a local_view_greedy demonstrator at all.

PROCESS LEARNING: an interpretation grid must enumerate a branch for 'manipulation succeeded and then decayed'. This grid enumerated only a ~0 null, so a successful manipulation was scored as a null. The covariate that catches it was already present and declared -- the defect was that the routing logic did not consume it. Diagnostic scripts should route on their declared covariates, not only on the terminal criterion.

cluster_pattern.shape: Three-leg GOV-FANOUT-1 portfolio adjudicated jointly, in which the legs' readings are mutually load-bearing and NONE is safely readable alone. 782 (shared CTRL instrumentation, no manipulation) establishes that the MECH-459 weak form does not hold, which makes 781's inside-the-normaliser null readable at face value. 781 (manipulation effective, competence null) eliminates the intrinsic-drive axis. 780 (manipulation effective in raw_view, competence ACHIEVED at 20.933 then eroded to 11.667) falsifies its own declared null's antecedent and therefore eliminates nothing -- while simultaneously supplying the positive control that makes 781's elimination trustworthy.
cluster_pattern.structural_property: The campaign has been asking a DISCOVERY question ('which mechanism produces competence') of a substrate whose actual deficit is RETENTION ('why is produced competence not held'). All ten previously-resolved legs intervened on discovery-side mechanisms and every one was adjudicated against a treatment arm that never left the ~0-1 floor -- so the retention deficit was structurally invisible to them: a mechanism that never produces competence cannot be observed failing to retain it. V3-EXQ-780's raw_view arm is the first arm in the campaign to clear the lift-competence target, and the deficit becomes visible in the same run. V3-EXQ-782 R-(b) independently measures a candidate mechanism (flat, uninformed critic on the shared control path) without knowing it was needed. This is one structural property, not three independent results.
readings: retention_not_discovery -- the competence floor is (at least partly) a failure to retain an installed competent policy under RL updating, with a flat uninformed critic as the leading mechanism candidate. Directly evidenced by 780 raw_view (20.933 -> 11.667) plus 782 R-(b) (std(V)/std(G) 0.041, separation 0.016).

consummation_binding -- 781's approach-without-consummation (drive earned 0.707, foraging suppressed to 0.200 from a 2.983 control) says the appetitive half is instantiable but is not bound to a consummatory act. Converges with the standing basal-ganglia-commitment reading of the conversion ceiling.
cluster_pattern.forces_planning_decision: The next portfolio on competence_floor should be a RETENTION discrimination, not another discovery-mechanism leg. The retention reading is newly opened by this cluster and is not yet a registered hypothesis leg; per the deferral decision below it is carried as a fanout_recommendation and will be pre-registered by the /queue-experiment that designs it.
cluster_pattern.joint_adjudication_was_load_bearing: YES, and demonstrably so in both directions. Adjudicated alone, 781's elimination would have rested on no demonstration that competence was reachable in this substrate at all -- 780 raw_view supplies that positive control. Adjudicated alone, 780 would have been recorded as eliminating H-bc-prior on a self-route whose declared antecedent its own covariate falsifies. GOV-FANOUT-1's premise -- that adjudicating a leg in isolation is how a confident-but-wrong elimination enters the frozen ledger -- is validated concretely here.

fanout_recommendation.deferral_rationale: DELIBERATELY NOT pre-registered by this autopsy. V3-EXQ-782's manifest pre-declared, BEFORE it ran, that a stays-tiny or already-concentrated reading routes to 'do NOT queue probe K, no registry write (counts stay 7/12)'. live_hypotheses: H-retention-critic: the value baseline is too flat/uninformed to refine an installed competent policy, so RL gradient noise drifts it off (782 R-(b): std(V)/std(G) = 0.041 vs a 0.25 collapse threshold; pre-reward-vs-far separation 0.016 vs a 0.25 floor).
H-retention-consolidation: there is no consolidation/protection pathway for an acquired policy, so any continued updating erodes it regardless of critic quality.
H-retention-auxiliary-decay: the persistent imitation auxiliary (bc_aux_coef=0.5) is out-competed by the RL objective over training, so the prior is not held rather than not protected.

H-consummation-binding: appetitive approach is not bound to a consummatory act, so drive-side interventions produce approach-and-dwell rather than consumption (781: drive earned 0.707 while foraging fell to 0.200 from a 2.983 control).

suggested_probes.sketch: BC-install to the raw_view 20.9 competence point, then run the SAME RL refinement with a distributional/twohot critic vs the current scalar critic. DV: competence trajectory post-installation, not terminal competence. Null: the installed prior erodes identically under both critics -> the critic baseline is not the retention mechanism.
BC-install, then RL with a trust-region / KL-anchor to the installed policy vs unconstrained. Null: anchoring does not preserve competence -> retention is not a drift-protection problem.

BC-install, then sweep bc_aux_coef persistence (constant vs annealed vs off) and measure the competence half-life. Null: half-life is invariant to the auxiliary schedule -> the prior is not being out-competed by the RL objective.

Approach drive gated to EXTINGUISH on resource contact and hand off to a consummatory act, vs 781's non-extinguishing terminal drive. Null: competence still flat -> the binding is not what 781 was missing.

fanout_recommendation.axis_family_caution: Three of the four proposed axes (algorithm, policy, learning-signal) map to the `process` family, which already contains 6 eliminated legs -- so a naive read would score this portfolio as CIRCLING. It is not the dead legs wearing new names, and the distinction is measurable rather than rhetorical: every eliminated process leg intervened on how competence is DISCOVERED and was adjudicated against a treatment arm that never left the ~0-1 floor (credit sweep 0.2-0.45; archive/return, curriculum, arbitration all collapsing to the sparse-RL baseline). These probes intervene on whether ALREADY-INSTALLED competence is RETAINED, are adjudicated against a 20.933 starting point, and read a competence TRAJECTORY rather than a terminal value. The prior legs could not have detected a retention deficit because their arms never produced competence to retain. If the designing /queue-experiment introduces a `retention` axis label, it must add a family row for it in axis_families.map in the same edit (an unmapped axis forces convergence_class to indeterminate) -- and it should state this reasoning explicitly rather than letting the family map decide the verdict silently.
fanout_recommendation.note: GOV-FANOUT-1 producer half. Fan out a diverse portfolio with each leg declaring its null; design-audit for coverage and verdict-aliasing before queuing. Anti-alias requirement: H-retention-critic and H-retention-consolidation can both produce 'competence preserved', so the audit must ensure their probes are separable (the critic probe changes the value estimator, the consolidation probe changes the update constraint; a leg that changes both aliases them). Every leg MUST record the post-installation competence trajectory, not just terminal competence -- terminal-only measurement is what made this deficit invisible for ten legs.
